value.rationale: An exact full-class choice of iid reshuffling probability is a natural algorithmic optimization question. Sharp random-to-deterministic phase change and divergent 1/h improvement over uniform reshuffling for unequal curvatures are mathematically substantive and cost no additional gradients. The equality of standard squared prefix-discrepancy diagnostics across permutations supplies a structural explanation of their insufficiency for this stationary metric.
